Cost Per Dose: 100eb (Premium)

An extremely powerful aerosol narcotic that makes the user’s mindscape easily manipulated by outside forces. Rather than torture, this is most often used to experience quasi-braindances for cheap.

⋙ PRIMARY EFFECT ⋘

  • Lasts 10 minutes.
  • For the duration of the Primary Effect, the user has vivid hallucinations of whatever anyone nearby tells them about, akin to experiencing a Braindance. The effect this has on the user is determined the GM depending on what kind of imagery the speaker gives to the user, such as reliving a retold memory, a fake story, or a fabricated nightmare.
  • For the duration of the Primary Effect, the user is effectively near-comatose and cannot take an Action or Move Action.

⋙ SECONDARY EFFECT (DV15) ⋘

  • If the user wasn’t already addicted to Deep Dive, they are now. While addicted, their INT and COOL are permanently reduced by 1.
  • While addicted to Deep Dive, the GM should occasionally inform the user when they crave more Deep Dive. Do your best to roleplay accordingly (e.g., begging others to tell you a fun story).

Cost: 100eb (Premium) per dose
Type: Street Drug

Foundry notes:

  • While addicted, switch on the "Deep Dive Addiction" effect.
  • Stat and skill changes are automated; caps, minimums, durations, and everything else are not.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Gear, Drugs, & Frames > Consumables > Street Drugs).
